sources.title: Text Embedding - Octen Docs
sources.snippet: SOTA retrieval quality. octen-embedding-8b and octen-embedding-4b rank #1 and #2 on the RTEB text-retrieval benchmark. Flexible model choice. Pick the model that fits your scenario and cost, from best accuracy to high-volume and low-cost. Retrieval-tuned.

sources.title: Embedding - Octen Docs
sources.snippet: The embedding model used for this request. octen-embedding-.6b (max dim: 1024) for cost/throughput priority; octen-embedding-4b (max dim: 2560) for most applications; octen-embedding-8b (max dim: 4096) for accuracy-critical tasks.
